items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Felix something -- that made my records when I would go to New York to record on that wax.

ctx.x: Yeah. Mr. Walker and -- I certainly wish I could remember the man's name -- Felix something -- that made my records when I would go to New York to record on that wax. He would take such interest and such pains with me to see that my records were right, you know. And he would even ruin good wax to play it over to see if I was doing all right, you know, in order for me to make a good record. And my record was the first record ever to sell 100 percent mechanical. It was on every phonograph label and piano rolls, and…
But you must be getting money now on 'Downhearted Blues'.
